business_problem: Docusign needed to overcome the limitations of its current systems, scale operations, and automate processes. By implementing AI-driven agreement lifecycle management, it sought to serve its global customer base more efficiently.
solution_summary: Docusign needed to overcome the limitations of its current systems, scale operations, and automate processes. By implementing AI-driven agreement lifecycle management, it sought to serve its global customer base more efficiently. The company turned to Azure to develop the Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) platform. IAM automates, scales, and enhances the agreement management processes using Azure AI, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Logic Apps, and AKS. With its revolutionary Azure-based platform, Docusign can now accelerate growth and scale globally. It supports millions of workflows, reducing contract processing times and enhancing customer satisfaction with advanced AI-powered analytics. Docusign, a leader in e-signature solutions with 1.6 million global customers, saw this challenge as a golden opportunity to reshape itself, along with the entire agreement management industry.

solution_components.role: Runs the large-language-model features for classification, summarization, retrieval, or conversational responses in the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure SQL Database
solution_components.role: Stores structured application and transactional data for the platform's core workflow.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Runs the customer's containerized applications and AI services on a managed Kubernetes platform.

data_flow: Source content is gathered from the organization's documents and knowledge repositories, Azure OpenAI Service interprets or generates responses from that content, and the resulting answers or assessments are surfaced to employees or citizens through the application workflow.
